spec.name: Baba Yaga's Hut on Chicken Legs
spec.description: A crooked log izba with painted Slavic carved trim, standing on two giant scaly chicken legs whose clawed feet grip the forest floor, facing the viewer with a red porch and door, a bright ridge roof, and a smoking chimney at the back.
spec.layout: The hut is a folk-art log izba lifted ~1.9 m off the ground on two oversized chicken legs. From front (+Z) to back: a red-painted porch with descending steps and railing sits at the hut's +Z face (its steps reach y=0, floor-true), the log wall face carries a carved door frame, two windows with painted shutters, and sills; behind, the log body is a simple crooked rectangle of horizontal logs with projecting corner log ends. Above y=3.75 sits the roof: steep wooden shingles on two slopes, wide carved overhanging boards (red with white and gold trim) that wrap all four sides like the classic Slavic 'okhap' gables, a green ridge board, two horse-head finials at the front and back gable ends of the ridge, and a smoking stone chimney poking through the rear slope. The chicken legs hang from the hut's underside at x=±0.55: feathered thighs tucked under the walls, bare scaly shins, and three-toed clawed feet splayed on the ground, each toe gripping a small stone. Ground dressing is minimal: a few pebbles and moss patches under the claws only. The style shows on every part: painted red/teal/gold carved boards, white trim, zig-zag plank ends, every small seam, eye-dot, boss and rune a separate flat-coloured part seated on the surface.

parts.builds: Both giant chicken legs, each riding its own leg joint (legL, legR). Each leg is a chain: a feathered thigh ~0.34 m wide tucked up under the hut's underside (featherBody with featherTip shaggy feather tufts and overlapping shag plates layered root-to-tip over the thigh, a few in trimWhite), narrowing to a bare scaly shin ~0.14 m wide in legScale with a footScale band of thick scutes built as small wedge parts around the ankle, a knee boss, and a knuckle. The foot at y=0: a chunky ankle block (footScale) and three forward toes (two forward-pointing, one angled slightly outward on each side) plus a small rear dew-toe, each toe a tapering knuckle chain ending in a sharp claw in claw (bone colour), with dark ink claw tips; claws bend downward and grip small stones of stone colour with moss patches on their upper faces, sitting on a low soil mound so every toe's lowest point touches y=0. Give each leg a slight outward splay (foot at x=±0.72) so the hut reads as balanced on bird legs. Add a few stray curved feather wisps floating near the thighs and one small rope-and-hook detail at each legTop where the log sill is bound to the leg. Budget includes the soil mounds and gripping stones.
parts.attaches: Legs hang from the hut's underside: thigh tops meet the mounts legTopL/legTopR on the sillLine at y=1.9, buried into the hutWalls part's bottom face; feet rest on the groundLine at y=0.

parts.builds: The log body of the izba, riding the hut joint: a crooked rectangular box of stacked horizontal logs ~0.22 m in diameter, 2.6 m wide (x), 2.5 m deep (z), from y=1.9 (sill, where the chicken legs attach) up to y=3.75 (eavesLine). Walls in log colour with logDark shadowed lower courses and a plank-coloured course at the sill; each log end projects ~0.12 m at the four corners as a dark logDark end disc with a carved ring groove (ink dot). The front face (+Z) carries the character: a tall carved door frame in accentRed with trimWhite zig-zag carved borders and a small gold sun rune above the lintel, the plank door itself with ink iron hinges, a handle boss, and a small round window in the door with glassGlow glass; either side of the door, two windows ~0.5 m wide with windowDark frames, glassGlow panes crossed by ink glazing bars, and the signature painted shutters (accentRed with trimWhite floral dots and a gold heart/star motif) hung on each side; below the windows, a trimWhite sill board with plank under-shadow. The side walls get one small square window each with a shutter, and a few ink nail dots and a small carved horse-and-sun charm board near the door. Top of the walls is a flat logDark eaves plate ring where the roof part lands. No roof, no legs, no porch in this part.
parts.attaches: Bottom sits on the sillLine (y=1.9) over the chickenLegs' thigh tops at legTopL/legTopR; front face meets the porch part at porchLine (z=1.3); top rim at eavesLine meets the roof part.

parts.builds: The steep roof riding the roofCap joint at eavesLine: two slopes of wooden shingles in shingle colour (individual small shingle strip parts in two staggered rows of tone per slope, plus shingle edges) pitched to a ridge at y≈5.0, overhangs extending ~0.55 m beyond the walls on all sides. Wrapped around the eaves, the wide carved fascia boards in roofBoard red with trimWhite zig-zag and gold diamond trim, with scalloped carved ends; the gable ends are the classic Slavic 'okhap' – the gable triangle filled with horizontally laid plank logs (plank) with a trimWhite carved sun-disc board at its centre, framed by roofBoard trim. Along the ridge, a ridge board in ridge teal with a trimWhite wave pattern, terminating in two horse-head finials at the +Z and −Z gable ends of the ridge: small stylized plank horse heads (plank with ink mane, trimWhite eyes and bridle, a gold dot earring) facing outward. A stone chimney (stone with logDark cap) pokes through the rear slope near z=−0.9, with a few smoke puffs (smoke-coloured rounded blobs) drifting up and a moss patch on the chimney's top. Under the eaves overhang, small trimWhite support brackets with carved ends at each corner. Roof must not extend below y=3.75 or past x=±1.8/z=±1.85.
parts.attaches: Bottom rim at eavesLine (y=3.75) sits exactly on the hutWalls' top plate; the chimney is the only part of this piece above or below those bounds.

parts.builds: The red front porch and its steps, riding the hut joint, hung from the hutWalls' front face at porchLine (z=1.3): a small open porch platform ~1.6 m wide with a plank deck, a roofBoard-red gable porch canopy on two turned wooden posts (logDark with gold ring bosses), its little roof echoing the main roof with a trimWhite ridge and one small carved bird finial facing +Z. The deck sits at y≈1.6, and three plank steps (plank with logDark risers and trimWhite carved tread edges) descend from the deck toward the viewer, the lowest step reaching y≈0 so its front edge rests on the groundLine (this part's lowest points touch y=0). A carved railing with balusters on the deck's sides (accentRed posts, trimWhite rail, gold finial balls), and a hanging sign board (a plank sign with a gold rooster silhouette and ink lettering-style notches, hung by a small chain from the canopy) facing +Z. The doorway threshold is left open so the hutWalls door face reads through. Add a tiny soil/pebble scatter under the lowest step so the step sits on y=0. Nothing else in this part: no props, no fence, no scenery beyond the step base and its pebbles.
parts.attaches: Back edge z=1.3 meets the hutWalls front face at porchLine; the deck top at y≈1.6 is below the sillLine, and the canopy top stays below the roof's front overhang; the lowest step rests on the groundLine at y=0.
